_about: Retrieval judgments. Relevance is anchored by a HEADING REGEX, never by chunk_id:
chunk ids are positional ({doc_id}#{index:04d}), so any change to sectioning
silently re-points them. That is not hypothetical -- an earlier judgment set
keyed on chunk_id survived a zone-splitting change with every id still resolving,
while #0110 had moved from a capital-adequacy article to 제97조(준수사항).
The ids looked fine and the metrics would have been garbage.
This is a REGRESSION FLOOR, not a benchmark. It is small, it is specific to the
Korean bill corpus, and its absolute numbers mean nothing against a different one.
What it is for: making the next retrieval change a measurement instead of an opinion.
`kind` groups queries by the failure they probe. Report per kind, never only the
mean: a change can lift the average while destroying one category.
vocabulary_match  the query reuses the document's own words
synonym_gap       the query uses a different surface for the same referent
particle_glue     the query noun carries 조사, the document's does not
cross_bill        several bills legislate it; finding the family is the point
negative          genuinely absent; anything confident here is a false positive

queries.why: 스테이블코인 appears in no bill; each coins its own term. The measured failure that motivated pipeline/aliases.tsv.
가상자산 for 디지털자산, plus 자본금 which the bills phrase as 건전성.

queries.query: 코인 발행사가 이용자 돈을 따로 보관해야 하나
queries.why: Colloquial phrasing throughout: 코인 for 디지털자산, 돈 for 예치금, 따로 보관 for 분리하여 예치.
Uses one bill's exact coinage. Must stay at rank 1: this is the category alias expansion could damage.
Verbatim heading match. A floor that any working keyword arm clears.
Pins that 인가/등록/신고 stay distinct regimes. excluded.tsv records why they must never be aliased.
사업자의 carries 조사. The fixture holds 제7조(신고한 업무의 요건) and 제12조(신고를 게을리한 자) as deliberate distractors.
사업자는 glued; the answer articles use the bare noun.
Two characters. The trigram tokenizer cannot match these at all, which is why bigrams were chosen.
Legislated by several bills under two different headings. Finding the family, not one member, is the point.
Three bills carry near-identical articles under the same heading.
Every bill has one, in 부칙. Regression guard for the MIN_CHUNK_CHARS bug that dropped 부칙 from 3 of 8 bills on a green build.
Guards against over-merging: excluded.tsv rejects 대주주 ≡ 임원, a Jaccard artifact of both being pointers to the same statute.
Absent from the corpus. sqlite-vec returns exactly k rows however distant, so this will still return candidates; what is measured is that nothing scores like a real hit.
Plausible financial-regulation phrasing with no referent here. Catches alias over-expansion, which inflates confidence on out-of-corpus queries.
